reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, ph.list_price_eur
FROM products p
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE ph.valid_to IS NULL
  AND ph.list_price_eur = (
    SELECT MAX(ph2.list_price_eur)
    FROM price_history ph2
    JOIN products p2 ON p2.product_id = ph2.product_id
    WHERE ph2.valid_to IS NULL
      AND p2.category_id = p.category_id
  )
alternatives:
WITH current_prices AS (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, ph.list_price_eur
  FROM products p
  JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE ph.valid_to IS NULL
),
category_top AS (
  -- one row per category
  SELECT category_id, MAX(list_price_eur) AS top_price_eur
  FROM current_prices
  GROUP BY category_id
)
SELECT c.product_id, c.category_id, c.list_price_eur
FROM current_prices c
JOIN category_top t ON t.category_id = c.category_id AND t.top_price_eur = c.list_price_eur

SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, ph.list_price_eur
FROM products p
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM products p2
  JOIN price_history ph2 ON ph2.product_id = p2.product_id AND ph2.valid_to IS NULL
  WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id
    AND ph2.list_price_eur > ph.list_price_eur
)

other_way.sql:
WITH current_prices AS (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, ph.list_price_eur
  FROM products p
  JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE ph.valid_to IS NULL
),
category_top AS (
  -- one row per category
  SELECT category_id, MAX(list_price_eur) AS top_price_eur
  FROM current_prices
  GROUP BY category_id
)
SELECT c.product_id, c.category_id, c.list_price_eur
FROM current_prices c
JOIN category_top t ON t.category_id = c.category_id AND t.top_price_eur = c.list_price_eur
other_way.tradeoff: A step with each category's top price, joined on category and price, keeps every tie and is easier to check by hand.

solver.query:
WITH cur AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, h.list_price_eur FROM products p JOIN price_history h ON h.product_id = p.product_id WHERE h.valid_to IS NULL)
SELECT product_id, category_id, list_price_eur FROM cur c WHERE list_price_eur = (SELECT MAX(c2.list_price_eur) FROM cur c2 WHERE c2.category_id = c.category_id)
